<thought>We need to determine the number of CH₃ groups in the unknown sample. The only way to infer this is by examining its NMR spectra. The most direct evidence comes from the ¹H NMR, where each methyl group typically appears as a singlet (or multiplet) around 0.8–1.2 ppm integrating for three protons. Therefore, we should first obtain the proton NMR spectrum of the sample.</thought>
